node: Travel and housing transaction infrastructure: property-management systems, channel managers, revenue-management software, mortgage/insurance workflows, and maintenance networks
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the travel/housing transaction-infrastructure node. The cleanest US-listed exposures found in this pass are vertical workflow platforms rather than consumer-facing brands: AppFolio for residential property-management systems, Agilysys for hospitality property-management/POS/workflow software, Blend Labs for mortgage and consumer-banking transaction workflows, and Frontdoor for home repair/warranty contractor-network infrastructure. Sabre and ICE are relevant reference anchors but were not included in the four-candidate list to keep this pass focused on smaller/mid-cap or more node-pure names. MeridianLink was identified as relevant historically but excluded because search evidence indicates it was taken private and delisted in October 2025.
